product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform for business, technology, and analytics teams that analyzes customer behavior to surface digital friction and errors, quantify business impact, and prioritize improvements.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes a digital analytics platform for business, technology, and analytics teams, and says it identifies customer struggle, business cost, and what to fix.

pricing_page.notes: Quantum Metric has a public pricing-plans page describing custom plans and sales contact for plans.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Quantum Metric’s customer case studies identify BMO and Alaska Airlines as customers. | named_customers.0: The official case study identifies BMO as a Quantum Metric customer. | named_customers.1: The official case study identifies Alaska Airlines as a Quantum Metric customer.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile places its size in the 201–500 employee band; independent workforce estimates also fall within that range.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies Colorado Springs, Colorado as its locality. | hq_country: Quantum Metric’s LinkedIn company profile gives the country as the United States and its locality as Colorado Springs, Colorado.

founded_year.notes: Quantum Metric’s official story timeline identifies 2015 as the year its founders established the company.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index presents a general insights blog dominated by product, perspectives, and trends/best-practices content; the index does not establish at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Quantum Metric University provides public product guides and multiple course and engineer collections, meeting the requirement for multiple product-documentation resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Lever postings inventory contains open roles but none of the job titles matches the specified AI, ML, or data-science role categories.

model_provider.notes: The official Felix Agentic FAQ explicitly says the product is powered by Google Gemini.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company security page states it has SOC 2 attestation, is ISO/IEC 27001 certified, and complies with GDPR; the requested list is limited to the named certifications/standards. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names a SOC 2 attestation. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly says the company is ISO/IEC 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly names GDPR among the global privacy standards with which it complies.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile labels the latest deal as Series B. | funding_date: The funding history dates the latest listed Series B round to January 2021. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest deal as a $200 million Series B and lists it as the newest disclosed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding history entry is January 2021, well before the 18-month lookback beginning May 2025, so no round in that interval is shown.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Quantum Metric Lever posting is titled Strategic Account Executive and includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Quantum Metric announced the launch of its Voice of Customer solution on September 16, 2026, inside the six-month period before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Caitlin Tucker’s profile shows a Chief Marketing Officer role at Quantum Metric starting in January 2026, within the 12 months before the specified date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A current Quantum Metric growth-marketing job posting names Salesforce, Hubspot, Qualified, Clay, and Tableau as marketing-technology-stack systems. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly names Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job posting explicitly names Hubspot. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job posting explicitly names Qualified. | crm_stack_signal.3: The job posting explicitly names Clay. | crm_stack_signal.4: The job posting explicitly names Tableau.
